# Optional overlay vendor files

Legacy Live2D/Pixi overlay bundles are not redistributed in this source preview.
In particular, the Live2D Cubism runtime has separate proprietary licensing;
the project MIT license does not grant rights to it. The existing renderer shows
its placeholder when the optional runtime is unavailable.

Do not obtain or redistribute these bundles through an unverified mirror.
Consult the relevant upstream licenses before enabling an avatar distribution.
Main Deck uses the npm dependencies described in the root lockfile.
